s01.h1: One Contract for Every Screen in Your Sales Gallery
s01.subheadingBodyCopy: Manzili specifies, installs, calibrates and maintains your touch tables, LED walls, immersive rooms and hologram displays under one Master Service Agreement.

s02.h2: One Supplier for Every Showroom Screen
s02.subheadingBodyCopy: When a gallery display freezes at a VIP launch, the AV integrator blames the software and the 3D studio blames the hardware. Manzili removes the finger-pointing by procuring, stress-testing and warranting the whole presentation setup under one contract.
s02.block01Body: 55- to 86-inch anti-glare capacitive touch tables, calibrated for several buyers exploring the masterplan at once. Built for all-day showroom use, with under 15 ms touch response, scratch-resistant glass and built-in thermal management.
block01Features: Several buyers can explore at once
s02.block02Body: Bezel-free LED video walls with pixel pitch down to 1.2 mm, calibrated for true architectural color, bright showroom daylight and a 120 Hz refresh rate, so the image stays sharp from every viewing distance.
block02Features: Holds contrast next to showroom windows
s02.block03Body: 270° and 360° immersive rooms and volumetric hologram displays, built as permanent showroom centerpieces. Supplied as owned assets with manufacturer warranty management, plus dedicated optical calibration and permanent installation.
s02.block04Body: Workstations with RTX 6000 Ada GPUs, installed in your sales gallery, run the Unreal Engine 5 app fully offline at a locked 60 FPS in 4K, with no network lag.
block04Features: Presentations don't depend on outside networks

s03.h2: How Turnkey Hardware Protects Your Launch
s03.card01Body: One contract covers display hardware, workstations, software and maintenance, so your CCO has one accountable partner.
s03.card02Body: Commercial-grade components, redundant workstations and local power backup keep presentations running through busy launch weekends.
s03.card03Chip: 2-hour dispatch on launch days · 4-hour standard support SLA
s03.card03Body: Riyadh-based technicians handle fast dispatch, routine preventive maintenance and on-the-spot spare-part swaps.

s04.subheadingBodyCopy: Every component is selected, tested and integrated for stable performance in Saudi showroom conditions, including high heat and bright daylight.
row5: Dual RTX 6000 Ada, 128 GB ECC RAM

s05.q1: Why contract showroom hardware through Manzili instead of separate AV vendors?
s05.a1: So one partner is accountable for the whole setup. Under our Master Service Agreement, Manzili handles specification, installation, calibration and support, so a display failure at a VIP event doesn't turn into a dispute between vendors.
s05.q2: What happens if a showroom touch table fails during a launch?
s05.a2: Backup units and dual-configured presentation machines on site take over straight away, so sales carry on. Our technicians then replace the faulty unit under our support terms: 2-hour dispatch on launch days · 4-hour standard support SLA.
s05.q3: Who maintains the hardware after launch?
s05.a3: Manzili does, under the same MSA, with 2-hour dispatch on launch days · 4-hour standard support SLA. Our team installs, calibrates and maintains hardware across Riyadh, Jeddah and the Eastern Province.

s07.eyebrow: One Master Service Agreement · 99.9% Presentation Uptime SLA

s07.subheadingBodyCopy: Share your gallery layout and launch date, and we'll specify the screens, workstations and support plan.
